notes: 10-K for fiscal 2025, the company's first annual report after its business combination. The contents list (lines 46 to 66) is not labeled; it omits Items 1A, 1B, 1C, 7A and 9A to 9C, which the body prints. The forward-looking statements and the summary of risk factors between the contents and 'Part I' (lines 67 to 308) belong to no Item. Every Item from 1 to 16 has a body heading, so nothing is absent. Items 1B, 9 and 16 ('None.'), Items 4 and 9C ('Not applicable.') and Item 6 ('[Reserved]', with the body 'Not applicable.') are nil answers, marked following the field definition in bench/src/labels.rs; Item 8 only says the statements are appended from page F-1 and is marked incorporated. Hard call (the labelers differed): Item 3 says the company may from time to time become involved in legal proceedings and is not currently a party to any whose outcome would be material; it is not marked, as in fresh3/0001047469-17-001630 and fresh3/0000939767-01-500016, which mark 'None.' answers but leave such an Item 3 unmarked. Item 7A gives its own text on Bitcoin price and custodian risk before the smaller reporting company sentence, and Item 9B its own trading arrangement statement, so neither is marked. Part III Items 10 to 14 print their own text (no proxy statement is incorporated). Item 15 holds the exhibit list. The filing ends at SIGNATURES (line 1559); the financial statements after the signatures belong to no Item. Not tagged small-cap: the cover checks the smaller reporting company box, but it gives a non-affiliate float of about $365.3 million at December 31, 2025, since no public market existed at June 30, 2025.
